1.consolidated_definition: Tontería, sandez. Burla, mueca burlona. Falta de ánimo, modo de hablar de una persona apocada.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Absurdity, foolishness. Mockery, mocking grimace. Lack of spirit, manner of speaking characteristic of a timid person.
